title: Vaccine-Associated Measles Encephalitis in Immunocompromised Child, California, USA.
ehr_evidence: Clinical case report of a single 1-year-old infant in California, USA, with laboratory confirmation via brain tissue sequencing and nasopharyngeal swab.
summary: Case report of a fatal vaccine-associated measles encephalitis in an immunocompromised 1-year-old child in California, USA, confirmed by whole-genome RNA sequencing of brain tissue showing biased matrix-gene hypermutation.
key_findings: 38.0% (68/179) of uracil-containing codons in the matrix (M) gene contained >1 uracil-to-cytosine mutation at levels ≥5%.
Metagenomic RNA sequencing of brain tissue acquired 50.7 million reads, 190,303 of which aligned to Edmonston-Enders (Moraten) MV.
The patient experienced persistent dysautonomia, respiratory failure, and myoclonus, and died shortly after extubation.
